panels.description: Actual values vs baseline mean ± 2.5σ. Red dashed lines = alert threshold.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, value, metric FROM (
  -- Actual tag values per workcell
  SELECT
    t.timestamp AS time,
    t.value,
    a.workcell AS metric
  FROM tag t
  JOIN asset a ON a.id = t.asset_id
  WHERE t.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND t.name = ${anomalous_tag:sqlstring}
    AND a.line = '${line}'

  UNION ALL

  -- Alert threshold line (z-score = 3.5)
  SELECT times.t, stats.threshold, 'Alert Threshold'
  FROM (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS times(t),
       (SELECT SUM(sum_value)/SUM(sample_count) + 3.5 * STDDEV_POP(avg_value) AS threshold
        FROM cagg_tag_stats_hourly c
        JOIN asset a ON a.id = c.asset_id
        WHERE c.name = ${anomalous_tag:sqlstring}
          AND a.line = '${line}'
          AND c.bucket >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
          AND c.bucket < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes') AS stats
) combined
ORDER BY time

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT t.name AS tag_name
FROM tag t
JOIN asset a ON a.id = t.asset_id
WHERE a.workcell != ''
  AND a.line = '${line}'
  AND t.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND (
    t.name LIKE '%_temp_c' OR t.name LIKE '%_bar'
    OR t.name LIKE '%_kpa' OR t.name LIKE '%_l_min'
    OR t.name LIKE '%_m3_h' OR t.name LIKE '%_kw'
    OR t.name LIKE '%_kwh' OR t.name LIKE '%_a'
    OR t.name LIKE '%_rpm' OR t.name LIKE '%_mm_s'
    OR t.name LIKE '%_nm'
  )
  AND t.name NOT IN (
    'cycle_count','good_count','scrap_count','blocked_by_buffer',
    'reject_count','defect_count','expulsion_count','spatter_count'
  )
  AND t.name NOT LIKE '%_position_mm'
  AND t.name NOT IN ('tcp_x','tcp_y','tcp_z','cycle_time_ms','travel_speed_mm_s','ram_speed_mm_s')
ORDER BY tag_name
